comments.body: With eth you can get access to publibike for a very good price, including electric bikes. It has the con of sometimes finding there are no electric bikes in the nearest stop. But I really like it because of the flexibility of being able to bike in one direction and later being able to choose a different method if for example it is raining, or you want to go to a different place where you can't bike.
comments.author: dag00dag33
